description: Self-upgrade via temporary clone-deployer: triggers reconfigure on the proxvex deployer-CT, which is detected as a self-upgrade and routed through the clone orchestrator. The clone runs the regular reconfigure pipeline against the source, producing a new CT that replaces the original. Validation: the new CT serves /api/version on the original IP, the orchestrator clone CT is auto-destroyed by clone-cleanup-service, the debug bundle is adopted under the same restart-key on the new CT.
